issues.display_title: Issue #1993: refactor(paypal): clean up dead capture branches and close APPROVAL_PENDING payment bypass in CaptureSubscription
issues.main_description_html:
Background

In gothru-dashboard, all recurring PayPal subscription flows (SUBSCRIBE, UPGRADE, DOWNGRADE, and BUY-STORAGE) have been migrated to the webhook-first architecture (UpgradeIntentProcessor, DowngradeIntentProcessor, BuyStorageIntentProcessor), where DB updates are finalized via webhook events and the frontend listens to the SSE status stream (/paypal/subscriptions/{id}/status-stream).

Frontend client-side capture (POST /paypal/subscriptions/capture) is now exclusively invoked when a user has a one-time subscription profile (one_time_payment === true).

However, the backend CaptureSubscription and its action handlers retain legacy dead branches that accept recurring subscription IDs with APPROVAL_PENDING or APPROVED statuses before actual payment capture. This introduces a critical vulnerability where an attacker can manually call POST /paypal/subscriptions/capture with an uncaptured subscription ID and receive an upgraded tier without paying.

Scope of Work

1. Remove Dead Recurring Branch & Close Payment Bypass in SubscribeHandler.php

  • Enforce that client-side capture is strictly dedicated to one-time payment orders (one_time_payment == 1).
  • For recurring subscriptions (one_time_payment == 0), reject client-initiated capture requests or require verified active status with real payment transactions. Reject any APPROVAL_PENDING status.
  • Ensure that recurring tier provisioning strictly occurs via verified webhook events.

2. Harden CaptureSubscription.php

  • In validateSubscriptionStatus(), remove tolerance for APPROVAL_PENDING and APPROVED. Only allow ACTIVE.
  • Require verified captured payment before executing database updates.
  • Remove dead/unused helper methods (e.g., extractPaymentDataFromSubscription()).

3. Harden Fallback Handlers (UpgradeHandler.php, BuyStorageHandler.php, DowngradeHandler.php)

  • In validateNewSubscriptionStatus(), eliminate APPROVAL_PENDING and APPROVED from allowed statuses (['ACTIVE'] only).
  • Ensure idempotency guards only resolve when the webhook has already finalized the transaction or when the subscription is verifiably active.

4. Unit Testing & Verification

  • Add regression tests verifying that:
    • Any capture request with status APPROVAL_PENDING or uncompleted payment throws HTTP 400.
    • One-time payment (one_time_payment == 1) continues to capture PayPal Orders and provision correctly.
    • Existing webhook intent processors and SSE streams remain unaffected.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Direct call to POST /paypal/subscriptions/capture with APPROVAL_PENDING subscription ID is rejected with HTTP 400.
  • Legitimate one-time payment captures proceed smoothly.
  • Dead branches and unused methods in CaptureSubscription are eliminated.
  • 100% test pass rate across PayPal test suites.

Result

Pull Request

  • PR: #1995
  • Branch: refactor/harden-paypal-capture-subscription-1993
  • Key Commit: fd0a596ad

Key Files Changed

  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/Actions/SubscribeHandler.php: Enforced one_time_payment == 1 only, rejected recurring subscriptions client-side with 400, removed dead recurring refund/cancel code.
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/CaptureSubscription.php: Enforced ACTIVE status only in validateSubscriptionStatus(), removed dead methods extractPaymentDataFromSubscription() and extractPaymentDataFromOrder().
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/Actions/UpgradeHandler.php: Enforced ACTIVE only in validateNewSubscriptionStatus().
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/Actions/BuyStorageHandler.php: Enforced ACTIVE only in validateNewSubscriptionStatus().
  • resources/lang/*/messages.php: Updated subscription_invalid_state across 18 languages to expect ACTIVE.
  • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/PaypalSubscriptionHardeningTest.php: Added comprehensive regression test coverage.

Test Results

  • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/PaypalSubscriptionHardeningTest.php: 11 tests, 66 assertions passed (100%).
  • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/UpgradeIntentProcessorTest.php: 9 tests, 17 assertions passed (100%).
  • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/BuyStorageHandlerPlanIdsTest.php: 6 tests, 7 assertions passed (100%).
  • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/UpgradeHandlerTransIdTest.php: 3 tests, 3 assertions passed (100%).
  • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/DowngradeHandlerTransIdTest.php: 3 tests, 3 assertions passed (100%).
  • tests/Http/Controllers/Payment/Paypal/BuyStorageHandlerTransIdTest.php: 3 tests, 3 assertions passed (100%).
  • tests/Routes/DeadRoutesCleanedIntegrityTest.php: 2 tests, 37 assertions passed (100%).

issues.display_title: Issue #2008: feat(internal): add endpoint to get virtual tour detail by tour key
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Consumer applications (such as Panorra, Villume, and internal GoThru tools) require an internal service-to-service endpoint to retrieve the complete details of a specific virtual tour using its tour_key and authenticated Keycloak user UUID (sub).

Endpoint Specification

  • Method & Path: GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}
  • Auth: keycloak-service-auth:gothru.tours.read (Keycloak RS256 token verification with caller allowlist)
  • Path Parameters:
    • uuid (required, string): RFC 4122 Keycloak user UUID (sub).
    • tour_key (required, string): Hosted tour unique key identifier.

Response Payload (200 OK)

{
  "data": {
    "tour_id": 820508,
    "tour_key": "u1NXOiVK",
    "lat": "45.6466825",
    "lng": "-73.5684739",
    "cid": "583554146763372625",
    "goverlay_active": "0",
    "foverlay_active": "0",
    "tour_name": "Gym Fit Forme",
    "creation_date": "2024-05-10 12:00:00",
    "last_update": "2024-05-15 14:30:00",
    "moderation_id": 123456,
    "thumbnail": "https://img.gothru.org/81/583554146763372625/YUt-n_kyb6MAAAQZB_pESA.jpg?resize=350x175&save=optimize&pad=bg:000001",
    "place_address": "123 Main St, Montreal, QC"
  }
}

Field Mapping & Business Logic

  • tour_id: from hosted_tours.tours.tour_id (int)
  • tour_key: from hosted_tours.tours.tour_key (string)
  • lat: from hosted_tours.tours.lat (string/null)
  • lng: from hosted_tours.tours.lng (string/null)
  • cid: from hosted_tours.tours.1_cid (string)
  • goverlay_active: from hosted_tours.tours.goverlay_active (string)
  • foverlay_active: from hosted_tours.tours.foverlay_active (string)
  • tour_name: from hosted_tours.tours.tour_name (string/null)
  • creation_date: from hosted_tours.tours.creation_date (string/null)
  • last_update: from hosted_tours.tours.last_update (string/null)
  • moderation_id: directly from hosted_tours.tours.moderation_id (always populated) (int)
  • thumbnail: resolved full CDN URL from moderation.4_panoramas by moderation_id (consistent with /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours)
  • place_address: from moderation.0_moderation.place_address by moderation_id (string/null)

Error Responses

  • 400 Bad Request: malformed UUID or empty tour_key
  • 401 Unauthorized: missing/invalid Keycloak Bearer token
  • 403 Forbidden: missing gothru.tours.read permission or untrusted client ID
  • 404 Not Found: virtual tour not found or not owned by the user
  • 500 Internal Server Error: unhandled database or server exception

Tasks & Acceptance Criteria

  • Register route GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key} in routes/internalRoutes.php under keycloak-service-auth:gothru.tours.read.
  • Create GetVirtualTourDetailInternalController with RFC 4122 UUID validation and tour_key validation.
  • Implement getVirtualTourDetailByKey in InternalVirtualTourRepository with multi-database resolution (hosted_tours.tours, moderation.0_moderation, moderation.4_panoramas).
  • Update API documentation in docs/v2/tours/management/internal-user-virtual-tours.md and index in docs/v2/tours/management/README.md.
  • Add comprehensive unit and route test coverage for controller, repository, and route definitions.

Result

  • Status: Implemented & PR Opened
  • Pull Request: #2009
  • Key Commits:
    • Implementation & Tests: 402c55245
    • Docs Indexing: 74aae8bbb
  • Verification & Test Pass Rates:
    • GetVirtualTourDetailInternalControllerTest: 5 tests, 23 assertions passed (100%).
    • InternalVirtualTourRepositoryTest: 19 tests, 103 assertions passed (100%).
    • InternalTourRoutesTest: 2 tests, 12 assertions passed (100%).
    • Full internal virtual tour test suite: 26 tests, 81 assertions passed (100%).

issues.display_title: Issue #2001: fix(tours): investigate and resolve 500 error on get blueline status endpoint
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Investigate and resolve HTTP 500 Internal Server Error when requesting the blueline status endpoint:
GET /sv/blueline/{moderation_id}/status (specifically reported on moderation ID 3382231).

Context & Suspected Cause

  1. Route: routes/svpublisherRoutes.php:22 (/blueline/{moderation_id}/status) handled by Tours\GetBluelineStatusController.
  2. Action: App\Actions\Tours\GetBluelineStatusAction executes StreetViewPublisherService::getBluelineStatus($moderationId).
  3. Error handling:
    • If the upstream service (StreetViewPublisherService) returns an unexpected status code (non-200) or error response format that does not match known text branches (no blue line sequence recorded..., sequence_id missing...), the action throws BluelineStatusFailedException.
    • ToursExceptionHttpMapper maps BluelineStatusFailedException (TOURS.SV_BLUELINE_STATUS_FAILED) directly to HTTP 500.
    • Any unhandled exception or parsing failure in the upstream payload may also bubble up as a 500 response.

Objectives

  • Reproduce and inspect the exact upstream response from the Street View publisher service for moderation ID 3382231.
  • Ensure proper upstream response parsing and error handling so that upstream statuses (e.g. 404, 400, 502) or missing records do not crash the endpoint with an uninformative 500 error.
  • Write unit/feature tests to cover both success and unexpected upstream responses.

Result

  • Modified Files:

issues.display_title: Issue #2002: feat(internal): add endpoint to get virtual tour panoramas by tour key
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Consumer applications (such as Panorra, Villume, and internal GoThru tools) require an internal service-to-service endpoint to retrieve the list of panoramas for a specific virtual tour using its tour_key and authenticated Keycloak user UUID (sub).

Endpoint Specification

  • Method & Path: GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}/panoramas
  • Auth: keycloak-service-auth:gothru.tours.read (Keycloak RS256 token verification with caller allowlist)
  • Path Parameters:
    • uuid (required, string): RFC 4122 Keycloak user UUID (sub).
    • tour_key (required, string): Hosted tour unique key identifier.
  • Query Parameters:
    • page (optional, int, default: 1): Page number (min: 1).
    • per_page (optional, int, default: 20): Records per page (min: 1, max: 100).

Response Payload (200 OK)

{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 128456,
      "sequence": 1,
      "name": "PANO_0001.jpg",
      "lat": "-7.942493",
      "lng": "112.953012",
      "altitude": 0
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "total": 1,
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "total_pages": 1
  }
}

Field Mapping & Sanitization

  • id: mapped from moderation.4_panoramas.Id (int)
  • sequence: mapped from moderation.4_panoramas.sequence (int)
  • name: mapped from moderation.4_panoramas.1_pano_name (string)
  • lat: mapped from moderation.4_panoramas.2_lat (string/null)
  • lng: mapped from moderation.4_panoramas.3_lng (string/null)
  • altitude: mapped from moderation.4_panoramas.altitude. Sanitized to 0 if value is NaN (case-insensitive), empty string "", or null.

issues.display_title: Issue #2007: fix(panoramas): fix add connection not linking panoramas in /panoramas/google/add-connection
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

When users add a panorama connection using POST /panoramas/google/add-connection, the API returns a success response (200 OK), but the connection is actually not saved or created. As a result:

  • The new connection does not appear in the panorama connections list.
  • The navigation link is not applied to Google Street View.

Expected Behavior

  • When adding a connection between two panoramas, the link should be properly saved and reflected both in GoThru and Google Street View.
  • If the connection fails to save or update, the API should return a proper error message instead of a false success response.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Successfully adding a connection links the panoramas and shows up in the connection list.
  • Connections are properly synchronized with Google Street View.
  • Appropriate error is returned if the connection fails.

Result

  • Key Commits: 5fd1adf42
  • Testing Verification: Unit test suite passing 100% (3/3 tests passed in PanoramasControllerAddConnectionTest.php, 4/4 tests passed in PanoramaRoutesTest.php).

issues.display_title: Issue #2010: feat(internal): add endpoint to get virtual tour panorama links by tour key
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Consumer applications (such as Panorra, Villume, and internal GoThru tools) require an internal service-to-service endpoint to retrieve panorama link polylines (connections) for a specific virtual tour using its tour_key and authenticated Keycloak user UUID (sub), mirroring the behavior of /v2/panoramas/links.

Endpoint Specification

  • Method & Path: GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}/links
  • Auth: keycloak-service-auth:gothru.tours.read (Keycloak RS256 token verification with caller allowlist)
  • Path Parameters:
    • uuid (required, string): RFC 4122 Keycloak user UUID (sub).
    • tour_key (required, string): Hosted tour unique key identifier.
  • Query Parameters:
    • level_id (optional, string): Filter connections by specific floor level / folder ID (replaces fid from v2).

Response Payload (200 OK)

{
  "data": [
    [
      ["112.953012", "-7.942493"],
      ["112.953080", "-7.942510"]
    ]
  ]
}

Behavior & Business Logic

  1. Validate {uuid} against RFC 4122 UUID syntax regex.
  2. Validate {tour_key} is non-empty.
  3. Resolve user via Keycloak sub with atomic JIT provisioning.
  4. Verify tour exists and is owned by the user in hosted_tours.tours (deactivated = '0').
  5. Resolve moderation_id from tour.
  6. Retrieve polyline coordinates using ConstellationClass::getConstellationPolylinesV1($moderationId, $levelId).
  7. Return unencrypted JSON response { "data": [...] }.

Error Responses

  • 400 Bad Request: malformed UUID or empty tour_key
  • 401 Unauthorized: missing/invalid Keycloak Bearer token
  • 403 Forbidden: missing gothru.tours.read permission or untrusted client ID
  • 404 Not Found: virtual tour not found or not owned by user
  • 500 Internal Server Error: unhandled database or server exception

Tasks & Acceptance Criteria

  • Register route GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours/{tour_key}/links in routes/internalRoutes.php under keycloak-service-auth:gothru.tours.read.
  • Create GetVirtualTourLinksInternalController with RFC 4122 UUID check, tour_key check, and level_id query extraction.
  • Implement getLinksByTourKey in InternalVirtualTourRepository calling ConstellationClass::getConstellationPolylinesV1.
  • Update documentation in docs/v2/tours/management/internal-user-virtual-tours.md and index in docs/v2/tours/management/README.md and docs/REGISTERED_APIS.md.
  • Add comprehensive unit and route test coverage for controller, repository, and route definitions.

Result

  • Pull Request: #2012
  • Key Commits: 67fbb2eb1, f911c6805
  • Verification & Test Pass Rates:
    • GetVirtualTourLinksInternalControllerTest: 8 tests, 31 assertions passed (100%).
    • InternalVirtualTourRepositoryTest: 25 tests, 109 assertions passed (100%).
    • InternalTourRoutesTest: 2 tests, 15 assertions passed (100%).
    • Full internal virtual tour test suite: 34 tests, 112 assertions passed (100%).
  • Live E2E Verification:
    • Authenticated via Keycloak SSO token (id.gothru.org, client gothru-service).
    • Target user: muhamad210501@gmail.com (uuid: 551341ac-704d-4e72-bb23-3e0e16bffcf3).
    • Target tour: mq6lzZpB ("Yummi Candles ® Distillery District", moderation_id: 3527743).
